name: Malaga Turismo
verdict: The tourism brand of the Ayuntamiento de Málaga (the city council's Área de Turismo). Nothing found.
note: Proposed none 2026-09-28 (PR #340): state ownership alone is not a tier; the city's tourism area has no record of serious abuses found. Note: Score and Change calls the vertical front logo 'Málaga Turismo'; the club's Ayuntamiento announcement calls the same space 'la marca Málaga en el lateral delantero'.
